# Prathamesh Belvalkar

> Solution Architect specializing in scalable backend systems and high-performance web apps with React, Node.js, NestJS, and Python. Explore portfolio and blog.

## Pages
- [Home](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/): Profile, experience, projects, and contact
- [Blog](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog): Technical articles on architecture, backend, frontend, AI, and DevOps

## Blog posts
- [AI Automation Workflows with Python](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/ai-python-automation-workflows): Lessons from building production AI pipelines — from prompt engineering to async task queues and observability that actually works.
- [Architecture Decision Records in Git: Stop Losing the Why](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/architecture-decision-records-in-git): Slack threads die. Confluence pages rot. Here is how I keep Architecture Decision Records in git with a lightweight MADR-style template, PR review, and code that points back to the decision.
- [Building Scalable APIs with NestJS](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/building-scalable-apis-nestjs): How I structure production-grade APIs with authentication, RBAC, validation, and clean module boundaries baked in from day one.
- [C4 Diagrams for the Right Audience](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/c4-diagrams-for-the-right-audience): Context for product, containers for DevOps, components for developers — how I use C4 zoom levels so architecture diagrams stop confusing the people who need them most.
- [Modern CSS Layout Techniques Worth Knowing](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/css-modern-layouts): Container queries, CSS Grid subgrid, logical properties, and the modern CSS features that make responsive layout genuinely enjoyable to write.
- [Data Flow Diagrams for AI Backends](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/data-flow-diagrams-for-ai-backends): How I draw request → retrieval → model → guardrails → persist flows for AI backends, with Mermaid sequences, PII-aware logging notes, and a FastAPI-shaped sketch of a generic RAG path.
- [Docker in Production: Beyond the Basics](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/docker-production-deployment): Multi-stage builds, minimal images, health checks, and secrets management — the Docker patterns that separate dev containers from production-grade deployments.
- [Evaluating Tech and Assisting the Solution Architect](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/evaluating-tech-and-assisting-the-solution-architect): Spikes, bake-offs, and risk registers — how I evaluate technologies as an Assistant Solution Architect and what I bring to the Solution Architect versus what I decide myself.
- [From Engineer to Assistant Solution Architect: What Actually Changes](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/from-engineer-to-assistant-solution-architect): Moving from shipping features to shaping systems: diagrams, design reviews, estimates, and guiding teams without becoming a bottleneck — a first-person look at the Assistant Solution Architect role.
- [Guiding Developers Without Being a Bottleneck](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/guiding-developers-without-being-a-bottleneck): Office hours, ADRs, and RFCs — how I guide developers as an Assistant Solution Architect without becoming the human approval gate for every pull request.
- [How I Run Architecture Design Reviews](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/how-i-run-architecture-design-reviews): A practical playbook for architecture design reviews: pre-reads, decision vs parking lot, questions that expose risk, and how to review the design without attacking the author.
- [Microservices Communication: Sync vs Async](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/microservices-communication-patterns): When to use synchronous HTTP between services and when to reach for a message queue — the decision framework that prevents distributed monolith antipatterns.
- [NFRs, Effort, and Infrastructure Cost](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/nfrs-effort-and-infrastructure-cost): How I turn latency, availability, and token spend into estimates leadership can use — with cost-driver diagrams and a small TypeScript model for AI backend planning.
- [The Node.js Event Loop: What You Actually Need to Know](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/nodejs-event-loop-deep-dive): A practical, no-nonsense breakdown of the event loop, the phases that matter for backend developers, and how blocking it destroys your API's throughput.
- [PostgreSQL Query Optimization in Practice](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/postgresql-query-optimization): EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index strategies, and the query patterns that actually kill database performance — lessons from profiling real production systems.
- [React Performance Patterns That Actually Matter](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/react-performance-patterns): Cutting through the noise — the React performance techniques that move the needle in real apps, and the ones that are mostly cargo cult.
- [System-Level Troubleshooting as an Architect](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/system-level-troubleshooting-as-an-architect): When production hurts across services, I ask whether it is the model, the queue, or the database — correlation IDs, incident sequences, and NestJS logging patterns that make system-level debugging tractable.
- [TypeScript Patterns That Eliminate Runtime Bugs](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/typescript-advanced-patterns): Advanced TypeScript techniques I use daily — discriminated unions, branded types, and template literals — that catch entire classes of bugs at compile time.
- [Working With Product, DevOps, and Business](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog/working-with-product-devops-and-business): Same architecture decision, three languages — how I translate NFRs and trade-offs for product, DevOps, and business partners without losing technical honesty.
